name: print-social-ad-vr-gadget-comparison-purple-hex
title: Purple VR gadget comparison ad with hexagon pattern
whatItIs: A square ad comparing two VR/gadget products side by side against a purple gradient with a faint hexagon-pattern texture, joined by a dotted radial guide line and an 'or' choice cue.
whatItMeans: Framing two products as an explicit either/or choice (rather than showing just one) helps a viewer quickly grasp there's a decision or comparison being marketed.
techniques: position two competing products symmetrically with a clear 'or' choice cue between them
add a subtle repeating hexagon texture for tech ambiance without overpowering the products
use dotted radial guide lines radiating from each product like measurement callouts

vocabulary.definition: a composition presenting two or more options side by side to aid a viewer's decision-making
